note: Sample structure from BUILD_PROMPT.md Appendix A. Sample data, not real progress.

intake-ramp.purpose: Sample: starts the run by releasing the ball down a ramp

gear-train.purpose: Sample: the falling ball turns a set of gears

lift-arm.purpose: Sample: an arm lifts the ball to the next level

spring-catch.purpose: Sample: a spring catches the ball and throws it on

wheel-drive.purpose: Sample: a wheel converts the ball's weight into a push

funnel.purpose: Sample: the ball tips a funnel that pours water

pendulum.purpose: Sample: a swinging pendulum knocks the ball forward

solar-updraft.purpose: Sample: warm air rises and turns a fan

water-tank.purpose: Sample: a tank fills and overflows on cue

turbine.purpose: Sample: water spins a turbine to finish the run
